elevationModel.note: Gameplay-relative conservative approximations. Copernicus DEM supplies the local absolute terrain datum but is too coarse to resolve station structures.

approximations: Platform and track construction state follows the 2026-08-20 OSM snapshot and may change.
Building heights use mapped levels where present, otherwise conservative type-based defaults.
Footway widths, tunnel clearances, platform heights, track-bed depth, fence thickness, and crossing widths are gameplay approximations.
Canopy and catenary styling is original Gone artwork aligned to mapped roof and electrified-rail geometry; individual fixtures are not survey positions.
The Peronul 4;5 stair is placed conservatively at the mapped junction of the passenger tunnel, its eastern branch, and the platform because the exact vertical structure is absent from OSM.
The Peronul 6;7 stair is placed conservatively at the mapped tunnel/platform intersection because the exact vertical structure is absent from OSM.
A short Peronul 1 connector bridges the six-metre mapping gap between the passenger footway and platform edge; its exact kerb or ramp form is unknown.

The conflicting line representation of Peronul 1 is retained as source artwork but is not itself walkable where it overlaps mapped rail; mapped passenger links provide safe access to the platform polygon.
The map footprint cuts unsupported outer corners from the source envelope instead of inventing filler buildings, vegetation, or surface detail.
Station interiors, service yards, and construction areas are intentionally inaccessible.
